prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic, cinematic late-night talk-show portrait of a generic adult actress with rich chestnut-brown hair styled in soft glossy waves, parted slightly to the side, and a bright warm infectious smile that radiates charm and friendliness. She is seated confidently on a fictional late-night talk-show set, behind a sleek wooden desk with a professional broadcast microphone placed in front of her, captured mid-laugh as if reacting to a humorous comment. She wears an elegant blue dress: the fitted top has delicate gold star patterns scattered across a deep navy background, while the flowing skirt displays an intricate cityscape illustration in navy, midnight blue and muted gold tones, bordered with refined red trim at the hem. Pair the outfit with gold strappy high-heeled sandals and relaxed naturally crossed legs. Use expressive eyes, subtle glowing makeup, softly defined brows, natural blush, glossy lips and realistic skin texture with cinematic highlights and shadows. Show a nighttime city skyline through large studio windows with glowing bokeh lights and neon reflections. Professional cinematic studio lighting with a soft key light, gentle rim light and warm ambient tones. Full-frame camera, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, ultra-sharp focus, hyper-realistic detail, high dynamic range, natural color grading and premium editorial photography quality. Preserve the original dress, joyful talk-show atmosphere and cityscape set without reproducing Emilia Clarke, Jimmy Fallon or any public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted text, duplicate microphone
